test_title: PYST 38 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect narration of the following statement from the given alternatives:

The officer said, "The library will be supplied with sufficient number of books within one month."

options.text: The officer said that the library would be supplied with sufficient number of books within one month.
The officer said that the library must be supplied with sufficient number of books within one month.
The officer said that the library has to be supplied with sufficient number of books within one month.
The officer said that the library ought to be supplied with sufficient number of books within one month.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The sentence provided is in indirect speech, where the reporting verb "said" has been used.
 
• **Key Conversion:**
 
 
• The direct speech, "The library will be supplied with sufficient number of books within one month," is converted to indirect speech by changing "will" to "would" to maintain the sequence of tenses.
 
• The phrase "the library will be supplied" becomes "the library would be supplied" in indirect narration.
 
• The rest of the sentence remains the same as it does not require additional changes for accurate indirect narration.
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• In indirect speech, quotation marks are removed.
 
• The sentence is restructured with the reporting verb followed by the indirect statement.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** The officer said that the library would be supplied with sufficient number of books within one month.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** The officer said that the library must be supplied with sufficient number of books within one month.
 
 
• Incorrect as "must" changes the modality and meaning of the sentence, implying an obligation rather than a statement of future supply.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** The officer said that the library has to be supplied with sufficient number of books within one month.
 
 
• Incorrect as "has to be supplied" uses present tense, which does not align with the past reporting verb "said."
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** The officer said that the library ought to be supplied with sufficient number of books within one month.
 
 
• Incorrect as "ought to be supplied" changes the tone of the statement, indicating a suggestion or moral obligation rather than a factual statement.
